summary: Recognize exec gate checks recorded before their deadline when reconciliation is delayed

replay.detail: No replay, migration or rebuild. Persisted timeout results are not rewritten.

schema.detail: No graph, database or driver receipt schema change.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A delayed reconciliation pass uses an eligible local self-actor exit receipt from the exact requested check when it was accepted strictly before the original deadline and the matching runtime has exited. Exit 0 passes, exit 1 schedules a recheck, and other statuses remain broken. Same-millisecond request and completion are ordered by the original writer sequence and canonical replica position. Ambiguous multiple launches and foreign-origin receipt/request evidence retain timeout behavior. Running, late, unproved or contradictory completion retains timeout behavior. A check that earlier builds would classify as timed out may now report its real exit result. Current local start observations and legacy admitted start claims bind the available incarnation; multiple launches retain timeout behavior.

downtime.detail: None beyond the normal daemon binary replacement.

recovery.detail: Timely completed checks are no longer faulted solely because their next reconciliation happens after the deadline. Existing recorded broken results are not rewritten. Actual execution limits, gate report refusals, partial-listing checks and existing result authority fences remain in force.
